name: apiKey
label: Google API key
help: Enter an API key from a Google Cloud project with the Chrome UX Report API enabled. Create one under **APIs & Services** > **Credentials** in the [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials).

name: sitemapUrl
label: Sitemap URL
help: Enter the full URL of your website's XML sitemap or sitemap index (e.g. https://www.example.com/sitemap.xml). Every page it lists on your website is imported.

pattern.message: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://

name: website
label: Website
help: Optional. Enter the website's origin when the sitemap is on a different host from the pages, such as a CDN, a `sitemaps.` subdomain, or the domain without www (e.g. https://www.example.com).

name: keyPages
label: Key pages
help: Optional. Enter the full URL of each page you want to track closely, one per line, such as your home page, top landing pages and checkout. Fills the **Key Pages** dashboard, which stays empty until you add some. Key pages don't count toward **Maximum pages**.

name: competitors
label: Competitor websites
help: Optional. Enter the origin of each competitor website to benchmark against, one per line, with no path (e.g. https://www.competitor.com). Fills the **Competitors** dashboard, which shows only your own website until you add some.

name: maxPages
label: Maximum pages
help: Optional. Limit how many sitemap pages are imported, not counting key pages. CrUX only has data for pages with enough Chrome traffic, so a lower limit keeps the import quick.
